description: This source file contains unit tests for the WindowPlacement utility functions. It verifies positioning logic like centering, top-right placement, and on-screen checks for NSWindow objects within a macOS application.

classes.name: WindowPlacementTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for verifying window placement functions in macOS using XCTest

methods.name: centered frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Tests that centeredFrame returns origin at zero and the specified size when given zero bounds

methods.name: centered frame clamps to bounds and centers
methods.description: Verifies centeredFrame clamps size to bounds and centers properly

methods.name: top right frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Checks that topRightFrame defaults to origin when bounds are zero

methods.name: top right frame clamps to bounds and applies padding
methods.description: Ensures topRightFrame positions window at top right with padding and clamps within bounds

methods.name: ensure on screen uses fallback when window offscreen
methods.description: Tests that ensureOnScreen correctly moves window on screen or applies fallback when window is off-screen

methods.name: ensure on screen does not move visible window
methods.description: Verifies ensureOnScreen maintains window position if it is already on a visible screen
